test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 11 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Ram walks at the speed of 12 km/hr and reaches his school 12 minutes late. If he walks at 16 km/hr, then he reaches 8 minutes before the scheduled time. What is the distance of his school from his house?
solution:
**Given:**

Speed 1 (S₁) = 12 km/hr

Speed 2 (S₂) = 16 km/hr

Time difference = 12 + 8 = 20 minutes = 20/60 hours = 1/3 hours

**Formula used:**

Distance (D) = Speed × Time

Time difference = Time at slower speed - Time at faster speed

**Calculation:**

Let Distance = D km

⇒ Time taken at 12 km/hr = D/12 hours

⇒ Time taken at 16 km/hr = D/16 hours

⇒ Time difference = D/12 - D/16

⇒ 1/3 = D/12 - D/16

⇒ 1/3 = (4D - 3D)/48

⇒ 1/3 = D/48

⇒ D = 48/3

⇒ D = 16 km

**∴ The distance of the school from Ram's house is 16 km.**
